gate: H-5: cross-check vs a published layout
criterion: within 25% of the data-patch subtotal, or an itemised explained difference
scope: Pass H models the DATA-PATCH SUBTOTAL only. The 97,344 factory and 73,008 routing qubits are outside the model; they are itemised here rather than absorbed into the tolerance, so the full 897,864 is reproduced line by line.
